name: Morse.IsSplitMorseChart
why: Same five conditions (C^infty chart with C^infty inverse on source/target, p in source, phi p = 0, f = f(p) - ||x||^2 + ||y||^2 on the source); Morse.morseQuad c v = c - ||v.1||^2 + ||v.2||^2 by definition. Equal for all arguments; only the order of the fields differs.
